study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
outcome: Agreement between 3D US and 3D MRI in LAD detection
cohort: Nulliparous women who underwent a standardized protocol of pelvic floor evaluations prior to pregnancy, and at 6 weeks and 6 months postpartum.
finding: Moderate agreement was found between 3D US and 3D MRI in the detection of levator ani defects, with more defects and discordance observed on the left side.
